description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Zipper, a purely functional zipper data structure implementation for lists, allowing efficient traversal and manipulation of list elements with methods for moving the focus, inserting, deleting, and splicing elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Zipper
classes.description: A class implementing a list zipper data structure with methods for traversal, insertion, deletion, and splicing operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the zipper with front and back arrays.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a zipper from an array with a hole at the 0th position, returning the zipper and the element at that position.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the zipper back into a normal array, optionally filling the hole with a specified value.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves the hole to the next element, returning the original element of the new hole.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the hole forward by a specified number of steps, filling it with a given element each time.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the hole to the previous element, returning the original element that was in the new hole.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the contents of the current hole, shifting the focus to the next element, and returns the deleted element.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Checks if the traversal has reached the end of the list (i.e., back list is empty).

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts an element before the current hole.

methods.name: insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts an element after the current hole.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Splices in multiple elements at the current hole, replacing a specified number of elements, and returns the old elements and the last inserted element.
